text: だれか　ビルに　しのび　こんだと　ロケットだんが　さわいでる　…　きみの　こと　らしいね

structure.jp: だれか　ビルに　しのび　こんだと
structure.en: that someone snuck into the building

structure.jp: ロケットだんが　さわいでる
structure.en: Team Rocket is making a fuss

structure.jp: …　きみの　こと　らしいね

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と comes right after the words someone is saying or shouting. しのび　こんだと　さわいでる = 'making a fuss that someone snuck in'.

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.span: きみの　こと　らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい at the end says 'it seems so', going by what you heard or saw. きみの　こと　らしい = 'it seems to be about you'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says something is going on right now; でる is the short spoken form of でいる. さわいでる = 'are making a fuss'.
